title: 2006 AMC 10B Problem 18
statement: Let \(a_1,\) \(a_2,\) \(\ldots\) be a sequence for which \(a_1=2,\) \(a_2=3,\) and \(a_n=\dfrac{a_{n-1}}{a_{n-2}}\) for each positive integer \(n\ge 3.\) What is \(a_{2006}?\)

solutions.text:
The terms are \(2,\,3,\,\tfrac32,\,\tfrac12,\,\tfrac13,\,\tfrac23,\) then \(2,\,3,\ldots,\) a cycle of length \(6.\)

Since \(2006=6\cdot334+2,\) we have \(a_{2006}=a_2=3.\)

Thus, the correct answer is E.
hints: Compute the first several terms to detect a repeating cycle
The sequence repeats every \(6\) terms; reduce \(2006\) modulo \(6\)
